text:
elaine: Quick QA roundup for the webinar landing + launch post. Need a final pass on keyword targeting, JSON-LD/schema variants (WebinarEvent + FAQ), internal linking anchors, and redirect decisions for the signup URL. Target publish Friday. :calendar: :rocket:

ryan: Can we lock the canonical and redirect behavior first? marketing wants /webinar-signup -> /pricing/signup to be a 301 but dev flagged timing. Also need tracking (UTM) mapping for lead routing.

priya: Re: schema — I'll attach a minimal JSON-LD stub for WebinarEvent + FAQ we can copy into the head. Will also include alternate schema if we keep the signup modal (use Event + potential Action).

priya: ```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "WebinarEvent",
  "name": "High-performance LLM inference: Launch & benchmark",
  "startDate": "2026-04-10T10:00:00-07:00",
  "endDate": "2026-04-10T11:00:00-07:00",
  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.com/webinar"},
  "organizer": {"@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference"},
  "description": "Live walkthrough of inference benchmarks, rollout strategies, and cost controls."
}
```

elaine: Nice — please also add 3-4 FAQ snippets for the FAQPage schema (short Q/A). Those help SERP snippets.

oliver: Lead routing matrix idea: map UTM_source values to lead queues in HubSpot. Quick example: `utm_source=webinar_blog` -> SDR-inbound, `utm_source=paid_search` -> paid-ops queue. Also suggest a fallback tag `utm=unknown-webinar` for manual triage.

oliver: For redirects, dev prefers a 302 during launch testing to avoid caching until we confirm signup flow. We should decide now: 302 for test window (48h) then flip to 301.

ryan: OK do 302 for the first 48h, then 301. Add header check in the release runbook. Also we need the canonical set to the canonical landing (rel=\"canonical\" -> /webinar).

sasha: Tiny internal-link plan: on the blog post, link to the landing with anchors: \"benchmarks\" (#benchmarks), \"rollout guide\" (#rollout), \"pricing impact\" (#pricing). Add contextual links from docs (Deployments > Dedicated) so link equity flows. Avoid exact-match anchor on brand terms; use descriptive anchors.

sasha: Quick checklist for final QA:
- Confirm schema JSON-LD present in <head>
- Verify FAQ snippets show up as JSON-LD
- Curl header check for redirects and caching
- Confirm canonical tag points to /webinar
- Confirm UTMs are preserved through signup flow
- Smoke test HubSpot mapping for 3 sample leads

sasha: Example curl (use to validate):
```bash
curl -I -L "https://redwood.com/webinar-signup?utm_source=webinar_blog"
# expect: HTTP/1.1 302 Found (during test) then final 200 on /pricing/signup
# check Server, Cache-Control, Location headers
```

elaine: Perfect. @priya can you commit the JSON-LD to the draft and @oliver can you send the UTM->queue mapping to sales ops? I'll draft the publish checklist in the doc so PMs can sign off.

publish-bot: Preview deployed: https://staging.redwood.com/webinar-landing (preview build: build-429). Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.com/previews/429.png

ryan: I ran the curl against the preview — headers look good, Location set to `/pricing/signup?utm_source=webinar_blog&utm_campaign=launch_apr` and `Cache-Control: max-age=0, private` so safe.

elaine: Great. Action items: priya add FAQ JSON-LD, oliver send UTMs to sales ops, sasha run the redirect header test during deploy, ryan flip 301 after 48h if no issues. I'll post final go/no-go tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
